pictures.author: Milan Suvajac
pictures.observed: Actually inspected front/side oblique photograph. Rose-brown wall panels with creamy yellow pilasters/cornices and raised round-headed window surrounds, ornamental grille glazing, tall square bell tower with tall round-headed dark upper louver fields, circular clocks and pediment. A dark gray swelling Baroque roof rises through a small square louvered lantern and narrower upper onion/cross. A narrower tall octagonal windowed satellite drum appears to the side, with dark shallow metal dome and cross. Base and much of the side roof obscured by trees; fine iconography and sculpture not reconstructed.

pictures.author: Niegodzisie
pictures.observed: Actually inspected snowy front/side whole exterior. Projecting tall square central entrance/bell tower, recessed round-headed timber portal at its base, narrow side entrance/window fields, cream trim on rose-brown panels, clock and high dark louver fields. Dark Baroque tower roof and small upper lantern/cross dominate five smaller domed drum forms behind. The front corner drums rise from curved shoulder gables. Wall cornice has shallow repeating ornament. Trees obscure some lower front and side, snow obscures roof finish; door and side bay rhythm remain approximate.

pictures.author: Christian Bickel
pictures.observed: Actually inspected older frontal exterior. The single projecting square bell tower stands between two narrower corner domed drums, with a broader central dome/drum behind. Bell tower has a low round-headed field, tall round-headed louver stage, round clock beneath triangular pediment and a two-part dark swelling roof with upper lantern. Front round-headed entry is visible through trees. Cream/yellow trim and rose wall panels vary with lighting/age; current tone remains approximate.

pictures.author: Bernard Gagnon
pictures.observed: Actually inspected eastern telephoto roof detail. Dark gray sheet-metal tower roof has a broad lower bulb, narrower square louvered lantern, tiered upper onion, ball and gold cross. A separate rounded metal dome is partly visible. Neighboring buildings obscure all lower cathedral geometry; used for roof profile only.
